findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 8 gradient fill(s): div.hero-card → radial-gradient(circle at 72% 50%, rgb(23, 35, 102) 0%, rgb(12, 17, 51) 58%, rgb(8, 12, 36) 100%) | div#heroDisc.surgical-disc → radial-gradient(circle at 38% 35%, rgb(106, 130, 255) 0%, rgb(50, 74, 205) 52%, rgb(29, 47, 163) 100%) | div.fan-card-overlay → linear-gradient(rgba(12, 17, 51, 0.65) 0%, rgba(12, 17, 51, 0.05) 45%, rgba(12, 17, 51, 0.35) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 5 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div#heroDisc.surgical-disc → rgba(50, 74, 205, 0.55) 0px 0px 120px 0px | div#heroPillTop.glass-pill.glass-pill-top → rgba(6, 10, 30, 0.28) 0px 16px 36px 0px | div#heroPillBottom.glass-pill.glass-pill-bottom → rgba(6, 10, 30, 0.28) 0px 16px 36px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 8 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div#etapas.steps-subsection 1320px | div.credential-item 733px | div.credential-item 733px | div#depoimentos.testimonials-subsection 1320px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 19 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 11 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 3 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "melhor solução" 2.8:1 needs 3:1; "ao novo" 2.8:1 needs 3:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.9:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (60px, 666px, 1001px, 619px, 639px, 742px, 84px); the three most used hold only 41% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Dr. Flávio Saraiva Odontologia" (screen 12, 100% hidden); "Dr. Flávio" (screen 12, 100% hidden); "100" (screen 12, 100% hidden); "500" (screen 12, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "100" (screen 12, 100% over a picture); "500" (screen 12, 100% over a picture); "Com quais queixas os pacientes me procuram" (screen 12, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 12 screens in a row: "Dr. Flávio Saraiva Odontologia"; "Com quais queixas os pacientes me procuram"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 6 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Com quais queixas os pacientes me procuram" → 3 lines (7 words, 32px); "Odontologia de precisão para qualquer caso clíni" → 3 lines (7 words, 32px); "Quando a estética em resina é a melhor solução" → 3 lines (9 words, 32px); "Odontologia planejada em cada detalhe" → 3 lines (5 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: 4 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The margins differ: 8px on the left, 20px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Facetas em resina composta" (8px from the left); "Harmonização completa de cor, " (8px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
